name: switch
title: Switch
description: An on/off switch on Base UI's Switch: a track that fills with the compound accent and a sliding thumb, in three sizes.
usage: Use Switch for a setting that takes effect as soon as it is flipped ("Auto-commit", "Read-only connection"), in settings panels and side panels. Wrap it in a FieldLabel with its text (the text may come first) inside a Field, and add a FieldDescription for what it does; group related switches in a FieldSet with a FieldLegend. With TanStack Form wire checked, onCheckedChange and onBlur to the field. For a choice that only applies when a form is submitted, use Checkbox; for a toolbar toggle, ToggleButton. The old sizes sm/md/lg still work for one release.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called when the user flips it.

props.name: size
props.description: Thumb size: small 12, medium 14 (Fluent's), large 16 px (size.icon.xs, sm, md); the track is two thumbs wide.

props.name: size (sm, md, lg)
props.description: The old size names, mapped to small, medium and large. Kept for one release.

props.name: name
props.description: The form field name of the hidden input; a Field's name wins.

props.name: required
props.description: Must be on before the form submits.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The track, role="switch"; data-slot="switch", data-size, data-checked. A hidden <input type="checkbox"> follows it.

slots.name: thumb
slots.description: The sliding thumb in color.bg.surface with elevation; data-slot="switch-thumb".

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer over the switch: color.interactive.hover off, color.accent.compound-hover on.

states.name: checked
states.description: On: a color.accent.compound track with a thumb in color.accent.compound-fg, at the end.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus: Fluent's double ring (@/lib/control focusRing).

states.name: invalid
states.description: In an invalid Field, while off: a color.status.danger.border outline.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Ignores interaction: Fluent's disabled stroke and thumb (color.bg.disabled track when on).

accessibility: Renders a <span role="switch"> with aria-checked and a hidden native input for forms; Tab reaches it, Space and Enter flip it.

Label it by wrapping it in a FieldLabel with its text; the text flips it too and enlarges the target beyond the track (WCAG 2.2 target size). Name the setting, not the state ("Auto-commit", not "Auto-commit on").
On and off differ by the thumb's position as well as the track colour; off, the track is outlined in color.border.strong and the thumb is color.fg.muted (both at least 3:1).
The thumb slides in the reading direction (right in LTR, left in RTL).
Focus shows Fluent's accent underline (shadow.focus-underline) (3:1 on every surface).
